description: Preserves a project-authored synthetic upstream-style assessment as MODEL_JUDGMENT without upgrading it to factual truth. The fixture demonstrates the normalization boundary and makes no claim about an external provider.

mappingPolicy.description: Map synthetic supported booleans to AFFIRMED or REJECTED MODEL_JUDGMENT assessments; force every predicateStatus to UNDETERMINED; preserve the aggregate result; never map payout fields to a recommendation or action.

predicates.description: Preserve the synthetic source's supported boolean as a typed assessment, not as an established predicate.

title: Synthetic no-evidence model-judgment normalization
